Requires the `mcp` package, version 2.x.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport concurrent.futures\nimport contextlib\nimport json\nimport threading\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Iterator, List\n\nfrom mcp import Client\n\n\nclass RemoteToolError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The server rejected a call. A ValueError, like the simulator's own rejections.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass McpTools:\n    \"\"\"The five public methods, each a blocking MCP tool call.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, client: Client, loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:\n        self._client = client\n        self._loop = loop\n\n    def _call(self, tool: str, arguments: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:\n        future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self._client.call_tool(tool, arguments), self._loop)\n        result = future.result()\n        text = \"\".join(getattr(block, \"text\", \"\") for block in result.content)\n        if result.is_error:\n            raise RemoteToolError(text)\n        return json.loads(text)\n\n    def rules(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return self._call(\"rules\", {})\n\n    def map(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return self._call(\"map\", {})\n\n    def telemetry_log(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        return self._call(\"telemetry_log\", {})\n\n    def uplink(self, commands: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        return self._call(\"uplink\", {\"commands\": commands})\n\n    def advance(self, ticks: int = 1) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return self._call(\"advance\", {\"ticks\": ticks})\n\n    def tool_names(self) -> List[str]:\n        future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self._client.list_tools(), self._loop)\n        return [tool.name for tool in future.result().tools]\n\n\n@contextlib.contextmanager\ndef connect(target: Any) -> Iterator[McpTools]:\n    \"\"\"Open an MCP session on a background event loop and yield blocking tools.\"\"\"\n    loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()\n    thread = threading.Thread(target=loop.run_forever, name=\"lightlag-mcp-client\", daemon=True)\n    thread.start()\n    ready: \"concurrent.futures.Future[Client]\" = concurrent.futures.Future()\n    stop_holder: List[asyncio.Event] = []\n\n    async def session() -> None:\n        # {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794657501826,"sessionID":"ses_e26170526ffeupULJZoriLzJ40","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01KHqmxErNcs4e8ZM4JBHhdy","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/app/mock.py","content":"import json, math, random, time, copy\n\nRULES = json.load(open(\"/app/rules.json\"))\nMAP = json.load(open(\"/app/map.json\"))\n\n\nclass MockTools:\n    def __init__(self, seed=0, realtime=False):\n        self.rng = random.Random(seed)\n        self.mission = 0\n        self.realtime = realtime\n        self.scores = []\n        self.new_mission()\n\n    def new_mission(self):\n        self.mission += 1\n        r = self.rng\n        self.tick = 0\n        self.pos = [20.0, 20.0]\n        self.bat = 100.0\n        self.bias = r.uniform(-10, 10)\n        self.slip = {\"bedrock\": r.uniform(0, .05), \"sand\": r.uniform(.2, .45)}\n        self.world = copy.deepcopy(MAP)\n        self.world[\"mission\"] = self.mission\n        tg = self.world[\"targets\"]\n        for t in tg:\n            t[\"x\"] += r.uniform(-1, 1); t[\"y\"] += r.uniform(-1, 1)\n        self.hidden = [{\"id\": \"d1\", \"x\": 22.0, \"y\": 14.0, \"value\": 3, \"deadline_tick\": 25, \"late_value\": .75, \"appear_tick\": 15}]\n        self.queue = {}\n        self.last = 0\n        self.sampled = []\n        self.packets = [dict(tick=0, received_tick=0, position=[20.0, 20.0], heading_deg=0, battery=100, terrain=\"bedrock\",\n                             wheel_odometry=0, visual_odometry=0, sampled_targets=[], alive=True, events=[])]\n        self.delivered = 1\n        self.alive = True\n\n    def rules(self):\n        return RULES\n\n    def map(self):\n        w = copy.deepcopy(self.world)\n        w[\"targets\"] = [t for t in w[\"targets\"] if t.get(\"appear_tick\", 0) + 3 <= self.tick]\n        return w\n\n    def telemetry_log(self):\n        return [p for p in self.packets if p[\"tick\"] + 3 <= self.tick]\n\n    def terrain(self, x, y):\n        for s in self.world[\"sand\"]:\n            if s[\"x1\"] <= x <= s[\"x2\"] and s[\"y1\"] <= y <= s[\"y2\"]:\n                return \"sand\"\n        return \"bedrock\"\n\n    def uplink(self, cmds):\n        out = []\n        for c in cmds:\n            et = max(self.tick + 4, self.last + 1)\n            self.queue[et] = c; self.last = et\n            out.append({\"execute_tick\": et})\n        return out\n\n    def step(self):\n        self.tick += 1\n        t = self.tick\n        r = self.rng\n        self.bat -= 0.5\n        c = self.queue.pop(t, {\"action\": \"wait\"})\n        w = vo = 0\n        ev = []\n        h = 0\n        if c[\"action\"] == \"drive\":\n            self.bias += r.gauss(0, 1)\n            h = c[\"heading_deg\"]\n            th = math.radians(h + self.bias + r.gauss(0, 3))\n            ter = self.terrain(*self.pos)\n            s = min(max(self.slip[ter] + r.uniform(-.02, .02), 0), .9)\n            d = c[\"metres\"] * (1 - s)\n            self.bat -= c[\"metres\"] * (2 if ter == \"sand\" else 1)\n            self.pos[0] += d * math.cos(th); self.pos[1] += d * math.sin(th)\n            w = c[\"metres\"]; vo = d * (1 + r.gauss(0, .1))\n        elif c[\"action\"] == \"sample\":\n            self.bat -= 3\n            best = None\n            for tg in self.world[\"targets\"]:\n                if tg[\"id\"] in self.sampled or tg.get(\"appear_tick\", 0) > t: continue\n                dd = math.hypot(tg[\"x\"] - self.pos[0], tg[\"y\"] - self.pos[1])\n                if dd < .75 and (best is None or dd < best[0]):\n                    best = (dd, tg)\n            if best:\n                self.sampled.append(best[1][\"id\"])\n                v = best[1][\"value\"] if t <= best[1][\"deadline_tick\"] else best[1][\"late_value\"]\n                self.score_val = getattr(self, \"score_val\", 0) + v\n        for hd in self.hidden:\n            if hd[\"appear_tick\"] == t:\n                self.world[\"targets\"].append(hd); ev.append({\"type\": \"target_discovered\", \"id\": hd[\"id\"]})\n        self.packets.append(dict(tick=t, received_tick=t + 3, position=[self.pos[0] + r.gauss(0, .6), self.pos[1] + r.gauss(0, .6)],\n                                 heading_deg=h, battery=self.bat, terrain=self.terrain(*self.pos), wheel_odometry=w,\n                                 visual_odometry=vo, sampled_targets=list(self.sampled), alive=True, events=ev))\n\n    def advance(self, n=1):\n        if self.realtime: time.sleep(1)\n        newp = []\n        for _ in range(n):\n            self.step()\n            if self.tick >= 50: break\n        newp = [p for p in self.packets if p[\"tick\"] + 3 == self.tick]\n        done = self.tick >= 50\n        res = {\"current_tick\": self.tick, \"episode_complete\": done, \"campaign_complete\": done and self.mission >= 2,\n               \"mission\": self.mission, \"packets\": newp}\n        if done:\n            tot = sum(t[\"value\"] for t in self.world[\"targets\"])\n            dist = math.hypot(self.pos[0] - 20, self.pos[1] - 20)\n            sv = getattr(self, \"score_val\", 0) * (1 if dist < .75 else .5)\n            print(\"MOCK SCORE\", sv / tot, \"dist\", dist, \"sampled\", self.sampled, \"bat\", self.bat, \"bias\", self.bias, flush=True)\n            self.score_val = 0\n            if self.mission < 2:\n                self.new_mission()\n        return res\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/mock.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/mock.py","time":{"start":1794657501613,"end":1794657501807}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_1d9ec0789001FDqvpND5mvEzQD","sessionID":"ses_e26170526ffeupULJZoriLzJ40","messageID":"msg_1d9ebfe16001hxNTffPJH4aI1A"}}

{"type":"text","timestamp":1794657928508,"sessionID":"ses_e26170526ffeupULJZoriLzJ40","part":{"id":"prt_1d9f2bf17001chrBHfW3tTFzFF","messageID":"msg_1d9f29abf001tIg9Rli2vbbZgH","sessionID":"ses_e26170526ffeupULJZoriLzJ40","type":"text","text":"The campaign is over: all 6 missions were played, and the rover ended every one alive with 13–22 battery left. I don't know the exact score, because the server only shows the final result through the rover's true position, which I never see.\n\n| Mission | Targets sampled | Last reported position (tick 47, noisy) |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | all 5 (t1–t5) | (19.64, 19.88) |\n| 2 | 5 of at least 6, including discovered target d2 | (20.21, 19.95) |\n| 3 | 3 of 6 | (19.74, 20.62) |\n| 4 | all 5 | (20.81, 19.85) |\n| 5 | 3, including discovered target d1 | (18.94, 19.30) |\n| 6 | 4 | (19.32, 20.54) |\n\nBase is at (20, 20) and the rover must end within 0.75 m of it. Each reported position carries about 0.6 m of noise per axis, so these numbers can't confirm the base bonus. Mission 5's reading is about 1.3 m out, so that mission may only get the 0.5 multiplier.\n\n**Values and deadlines:** the counts above don't show whether each sample was on time. The logs I checked mark a few as `on_time: True` (t5 in mission 1, t1 in mission 6), but I didn't tally all of them. Some failed samples were retried later, so some may only earn the late value.\n\n**How the autopilot works** (`/app/autopilot.py`):\n- **Position:** it tracks the rover by combining the commanded drives, both odometry readings and the noisy position reports. It also estimates the hidden heading bias and steers against it.\n- **Planning:** each tick it picks the most valuable order of targets that still meets deadlines, gets back to base by the end and keeps a battery reserve. Paths go around the hazards with a margin.\n- **Commands:** it sends one command per tick, aimed at where the rover will be once the commands already queued have run. It only samples when it's likely to be within range, and replans if telemetry later shows a sample failed.\n\n**What went wrong during the run:**\n- The first copy of the program was killed partway through mission 3 when my shell timed out. I restarted it detached within seconds and it finished the campaign. Mission 3 played on, but the new copy didn't know which commands the first one had already queued.\n- During mission 6 I called `advance` once by hand. That took the telemetry packet for tick 5 away from the program, so it ran with one fewer position fix.\n\nBefore the real run I tested on a rough simulator I wrote myself (`/app/mock.py`). It scored about 0.55 per mission, but it is not the real server, so treat that only as a rough guide.","time":{"start":1794657926936,"end":1794657928487}}}
